name: Call of the Place
triggerText: When a mortal lingers in, approaches, or disturbs the spirit's place.
familyNotes: Path-twisting, fascination, beckoning voices, warning signs, or the sense that the land itself is guiding the target toward safety or death.
description: The being lures, warns, or unsettles through the voice and mood of its place.

magicEffects.Description: Lure or unsettle a mortal trespassing in the spirit's seat.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A mortal who lingers in, approaches, or disturbs the spirit's place.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target hesitates, loses certainty, or follows a false impression.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is lured, turned around, or drawn into danger.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for path-twisting, fascination, beckoning voices, warning signs, or the sense that the land itself is guiding the target.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Leave the place, receive trustworthy guidance, or the spirit withdraws.
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Trusted guidance, prayer, iron token, or clear landmark

name: Grasp of Root and Stone
triggerText: When a trespasser pushes deeper into the spirit's immediate domain.
familyNotes: Domain variants can restyle this as roots, reeds, scree, bog-suction, river pull, grasping branches, yard-tools, fences, or household obstacles.
description: The place itself hinders, seizes, or throws down an intruder.

magicEffects.Description: Seize the trespasser with root, mud, water, stone, or sudden terrain.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A trespasser within the spirit's immediate domain.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target stumbles, slows, or is briefly caught.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is held in place by root, mud, water, stone, or sudden terrain shift.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use the domain's natural material: roots, reeds, scree, bog-suction, river pull, grasping branches, yard-tools, fences, or household obstacles.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Escape, scene ends, or the spirit releases the target.
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Force free, cut loose, sacred aid, or leaving the terrain

name: Slip Into the Land
triggerText: When the spirit wishes to vanish or move through its natural seat unseen.
familyNotes: Slipping behind trunks, into water, through reeds, under stone shadow, or into the presence of the place itself.
description: The being vanishes into its natural seat or moves through it unnaturally.

magicEffects.Description: The spirit conceals itself within the substance of its place.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: The Nature Spirit itself.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Slipping behind trunks, into water, through reeds, under stone shadow, or into the presence of the place itself.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Reveals itself, attacks openly, or leaves meaningful cover from its place.
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Fire, desecration, forced exposure, or leaving the natural seat
magicEffects.SuppressedBy: In barren or fully exposed ground away from its natural seat

name: Blessing of the Place
triggerText: When a mortal honors the spirit's seat with gift, courtesy, or offering.
rangeText: Touch, gift, water, shade, or spoken favor
familyNotes: Hostile or offended variants can swap Blessed for Cursed or IllLuck.
description: The spirit grants aid, safe passage, or vitality to one who honors its place.

magicEffects.Description: Mark the honored mortal with the place's favor.
magicEffects.TargetRange: Touch, gift, water, shade, or spoken favor
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A mortal or creature shown favor within the spirit's place.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Hostile or offended variants can swap Blessed for Cursed or IllLuck.
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Favor exhausted, offense committed, or place left behind

name: Savage Rush
triggerText: When the Beast closes distance or commits to a charge.
familyNotes: Sudden lunges, closing distance, knocking into a target, or forcing a retreat.
description: The animal surges forward with sudden speed and violence.

magicEffects.Description: Surge forward with charge momentum.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: The Beast itself.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for sudden lunges, closing distance, knocking into a target, or forcing a retreat.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: After the rush resolves or the scene changes.

name: Maul
triggerText: When the Beast's natural weapons land on a target within reach.
familyNotes: Bite, claw, trample, tusk-gore, or rending hold per domain or body plan.
description: A brutal close attack that weakens, tears, or crushes.

magicEffects.Description: Maul the target and leave them weakened.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target within reach of the Beast's natural weapons.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target is battered, cut, or driven back.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Domain or role variants can style this as a bite, clawing, trampling, tusk-gore, or rending hold.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: End of scene or recovery

magicEffects.Description: Direct physical harm from the attack.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target within reach.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Secondary direct-harm payload alongside the Weakened condition.

name: Break Away
triggerText: When the Beast slips a hold, flees, or repositions instinctively.
familyNotes: Fleeing into brush, slipping from a hold, circling away, or disappearing into ordinary natural cover.
description: The animal slips free, bolts, or repositions with instinctive speed.

magicEffects.Description: Vanish into ordinary natural cover.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: The Beast itself.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for fleeing into brush, slipping from a hold, circling away, or disappearing into ordinary natural cover.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Reveals itself, is cornered, or runs out of cover.
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Cornering, nets, enclosure, or overwhelming pursuit

name: Brush of Glamour
triggerText: When a mortal meets the being's gaze, hears its call, or lingers in its presence.
familyNotes: Uncertainty, second-guessing, false safety, glamour haze, or difficulty judging what is truly present.
description: Clouds the target's judgment with uncertainty and false impressions.

magicEffects.Description: Cloud judgment with glamour.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A mortal who meets its gaze, hears its call, or lingers in its presence.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is filled with doubt and false confidence.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for uncertainty, second-guessing, false safety, glamour haze, or the difficulty of judging what is truly present when dealing with Hidden Folk.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Leave the scene, receive trusted guidance, or break the glamour.

name: Cold Hand
triggerText: When the Hidden Folk's grasp finds a target.
familyNotes: Numbness, trembling, fear-laced chill, or slowed reactions.
description: A numbing touch that chills flesh and weakens resolve.

magicEffects.Description: Chill the target and leave them weakened.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target within reach.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is weakened by grave-cold or glamour-cold.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for numbness, trembling, fear-laced chill, or slowed reactions.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: End of scene or warmth/restoration

magicEffects.Description: The touch inflicts minor direct harm.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target within reach.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Sanitised from spec's 1d6-2 to a non-negative range (1d4).

name: Slip Aside
triggerText: When the Hidden Folk wishes to withdraw or avoid retaliation.
familyNotes: Slipping behind cover, stepping partly out of ordinary sight, breaking line of sight, or resisting immediate reprisal.
description: Withdraws into shadow, angle, or half-seen confusion.

magicEffects.Description: Withdraw into shadow, confusion, or a half-seen angle.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: The Hidden Folk itself.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use to justify slipping behind cover, stepping partly out of ordinary sight, breaking line of sight, or resisting immediate reprisal.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Reveals itself, attacks openly, or concealment is broken
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Sunlight, cornering, holy sign, direct reveal

name: Return Unbidden
triggerText: When the dead presence reasserts itself where rest, absence, or closure should have prevailed.
familyNotes: Rising again, manifesting, appearing where burial or memory binds it, or asserting continued presence.
description: The dead presence reasserts itself where rest, absence, or closure should have prevailed.

magicEffects.Description: Reassert continued presence against rest or absence.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: The Undead itself.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for rising again, manifesting, appearing where burial or memory binds it, or asserting continued presence when it should have been gone.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: After the return resolves, proper rites are completed, or the scene changes.

name: Touch of the Grave
triggerText: When the dead thing's contact lands.
rangeText: Touch, grasp, strike, or close spiritual contact
familyNotes: Revenant blow, ghost-touch, draugr grip, wasting kiss, drowning pull, or fetch-contact.
description: The dead thing's contact carries weakness, chill, wasting, or spiritual harm.

magicEffects.Description: Weaken the target with grave contact.
magicEffects.TargetRange: Touch, grasp, strike, or close spiritual contact
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target touched by corpse, spirit, cold hand, drowning grasp, or grave-tainted nearness.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target is chilled, shaken, or spiritually tainted.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is weakened by grave-cold, wasting, drowning pull, corpse-force, or death pressure.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Variants can style this as revenant blow, ghost-touch, draugr grip, wasting kiss, drowning pull, or fetch-contact.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: End of scene or recovery

magicEffects.Description: The contact inflicts direct bodily or spiritual harm.
magicEffects.TargetRange: Touch, grasp, strike, or close spiritual contact
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target caught by the Undead.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Direct-harm payload alongside the Weakened condition.

name: Presence of the Unquiet
triggerText: When the dead thing's nearness stirs dread, grief, or guilt.
rangeText: Sight, memory, cry, or felt presence
familyNotes: Sorrow, fascination, guilt, drowning panic, or corpse-fear depending on subtype.
description: The dead thing's nearness stirs dread, grief, guilt, or the fear that death has not been properly kept.

magicEffects.Description: Stir dread, grief, or guilt with grave presence.
magicEffects.TargetRange: Sight, memory, cry, or felt presence
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A mortal or lesser being that confronts or recognizes the Undead.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target recoils, hesitates, or feels the pull of old grief or dread.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is overcome by fear, grief, guilt, or the horror of improper death.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Variants may lean toward sorrow, fascination, guilt, drowning panic, or corpse-fear depending on subtype.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Leave the presence, receive blessing, regain nerve, or the scene changes.

name: Sovereign Presence
triggerText: When mortals stand before the being or address it directly.
familyNotes: Even favor from the Unseen should feel weighty and unequal.
description: The being's presence imposes awe, dread, and emotional disorientation.

magicEffects.Description: Impose awe, pressure, and emotional disorientation.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A mortal who stands before the being or addresses it directly.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target hesitates, lowers their gaze, or loses certainty.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is overcome by dread or majesty.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Gentler variants may use SocialFavor or Doubt instead of Afraid, but even favor from the Unseen should feel weighty and unequal.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Leave the presence, scene ends, or the being dismisses the pressure.
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Blessing, command from higher authority, or withdrawal

name: Word of Binding
triggerText: When the being speaks a command in voice or formal address.
familyNotes: Milder variants can use TruthPressure; the speech still carries the sense of higher authority.
description: The being's spoken command carries supernatural force.

magicEffects.Description: Compel obedience with a spoken command.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A mortal or lesser being that can hear and understand the command.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target struggles, delays, or obeys imperfectly.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: A milder base variant can use TruthPressure instead of direct obedience, but the speech should still carry the sense of higher authority.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Command fulfilled, scene ends, or stronger authority intervenes.

name: Pass Unbarred
triggerText: When the being chooses to cross threshold, distance, or barrier.
familyNotes: Crossing barriers, ignoring common obstruction, arriving and departing unnaturally as a being not constrained like ordinary creatures.
description: The being crosses threshold, distance, or barrier in an uncanny manner.

magicEffects.Description: Cross distance, threshold, or barrier in an uncanny manner.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: The Unseen itself.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for crossing barriers, ignoring common obstruction, or arriving and departing unnaturally as a being not constrained like ordinary people or creatures.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: The being chooses to remain plainly present, or the scene changes.
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Powerful ward, true-name binding, stronger threshold
magicEffects.SuppressedBy: A ward specifically strong enough to bar the being

name: Bestow or Withhold
triggerText: When the being judges a mortal worthy or unworthy.
familyNotes: In hostile use, swap Blessed for Cursed.
description: The being grants favor or lays displeasure upon a mortal.

magicEffects.Description: Bestow favor or judgment upon a mortal.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A mortal judged worthy or unworthy.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: In hostile use, swap Blessed for Cursed.
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Gift returned, offense made, rite completed

name: Presence of the Outer War
triggerText: When mortals confront the Unnatural directly.
familyNotes: Variants may shift toward Shame, Obedience, Doubt, Fascination, or Zeal depending on faction and role.
description: The being's mere nearness presses mortals toward dread, compromise, zeal, or submission.

magicEffects.Description: Press dread, compromise, or submission onto a mortal.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A mortal or lesser being that confronts the Unnatural directly.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target hesitates, falters, or feels the pressure of unwanted spiritual attention.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is overcome by dread, awe, temptation, zeal, or disorientation.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Variants may shift toward Shame, Obedience, Doubt, Fascination, or Zeal depending on faction and role.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Leave the presence, scene ends, or pressure is ritually broken.

name: Word of Temptation or Command
triggerText: When the being speaks with force to seduce, recruit, condemn, or bind.
familyNotes: Angelic variants feel judicial; infernal contractual; demonic corruptive, possessive, or predatory.
description: The being speaks with force that seduces, recruits, condemns, or binds.

magicEffects.Description: Seduce, recruit, or compel obedience.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target that can hear and understand the being.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target struggles, delays, or inwardly resists.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target yields to command, condemnation, bargain, seduction, or recruitment pressure.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Angelic variants may feel judicial or doctrinal; infernal ones contractual; demonic ones corruptive, possessive, or predatory.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Command fulfilled, scene ends, or stronger authority intervenes.

name: Enter Unbidden
triggerText: When the being crosses boundary, ward, or placement in a way that should not be possible.
familyNotes: Unlawful entry, slipping through weakened wards, appearing where summoned, entering by invitation, or withdrawing from ordinary reach.
description: The being crosses boundary, ward, or ordinary placement in a way that should not be possible.

magicEffects.Description: Cross boundary, ward, or placement unnaturally.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: The Unnatural itself.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for unlawful entry, slipping through weakened wards, appearing where summoned, entering by invitation, or withdrawing from ordinary reach.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: The being remains plainly present, is strongly warded, or the scene changes.
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Consecration, exorcism, true-name binding, stronger ward
magicEffects.SuppressedBy: A proper ward, true prohibition, or law that specifically bars its kind

name: Obey the Imprint
triggerText: When the Construct recommits to its shaping command or labor.
familyNotes: Resuming a command, pressing a guard routine, continuing labor through harm, or acting with tireless imposed intent.
description: The made being recommits to its shaping command, labor, or warding function.

magicEffects.Description: Recommit to imprinted task with mechanical force.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: The Construct itself.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for resuming a command, pressing a guard routine, continuing labor through harm, or acting with tireless imposed intent.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: After the push resolves, the command ends, or the scene changes.
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Counter-command, disruption of sigil, physical disablement
magicEffects.SuppressedBy: Broken control, erased inscription, command conflict

name: Crafted Strike
triggerText: When the Construct's built force lands on a target.
familyNotes: Stone fist, iron grip, stitched claw, alchemical sting, or homunculus bite.
description: The being attacks with built force, shaped limb, tool-body, or unnatural precision.

magicEffects.Description: Strike with artificed force, leaving the target weakened.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target within reach of the Construct's body, tool, claw, hand, or fashioned appendage.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target is struck, shoved, or rattled.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is solidly hit and weakened by artificed force.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Variants may style this as stone fist, iron grip, stitched claw, alchemical sting, or homunculus bite.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: End of scene or recovery

magicEffects.Description: Direct bodily harm.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target struck by the Construct.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Direct-harm payload alongside the Weakened condition.

name: Tireless Function
triggerText: When the Construct withdraws from confusion or pain back to task.
familyNotes: Bracing, absorbing impact, stepping back into formation, shielding its core, or continuing a routine without ordinary fear.
description: The being withdraws from confusion, pain, or panic and returns to task.

magicEffects.Description: Withdraw and return to imprinted task.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: The Construct itself.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for bracing, absorbing impact, stepping back into formation, shielding its core, or continuing a routine without ordinary fear.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Re-engages openly, the task changes, or the scene ends.
magicEffects.SuppressedBy: Broken frame, shattered control, command disruption

name: Crushing Advance
triggerText: When the Colossus moves through ground, line, or formation.
familyNotes: Trampling advance, driving through a line, breaching a hull, scattering lesser foes, or forcing retreat by sheer mass.
description: The being forces ground, line, and formation to yield before its movement.

magicEffects.Description: Force ground and formation to yield before its mass.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: The Colossus itself.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for trampling advance, driving through a line, breaching a hull, scattering lesser foes, or forcing retreat by sheer mass.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: After the advance resolves or the scene changes.
magicEffects.SuppressedBy: Severe confinement, immobilization, or terrain that truly bars such mass

name: Titanic Blow
triggerText: When the Colossus's body, limb, tail, tentacle, or wing strikes home.
familyNotes: Claw, bite, tail, tentacle, wing, slam, surge, or body-check.
description: A single immense strike that batters, crushes, or hurls a target aside.

magicEffects.Description: Batter the target with overwhelming force.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target struck by the Colossus's body, limb, tail, tentacle, or other massive force.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target is staggered, driven back, or nearly broken.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is struck down and weakened by overwhelming force.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Variants may style this as claw, bite, tail, tentacle, wing, slam, surge, or body-check.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: End of scene or recovery

magicEffects.Description: Devastating direct harm.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target struck by overwhelming force.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Direct-harm payload alongside the Weakened condition.

name: Roar or Surge of Dread
triggerText: When the Colossus is plainly perceived by mortals.
familyNotes: Dragon-roar, kraken emergence, leviathan breaking the water, or the sudden realization that something enormous is awake and near.
description: The being's voice, movement, or emergence shatters nerve.

magicEffects.Description: Shatter nerve with the being's scale.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A mortal or lesser being that witnesses the Colossus plainly.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target hesitates, falters, or loses formation.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is overcome by fear or awe at the being's scale.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for dragon-roar, kraken emergence, the sight of a leviathan breaking the water, or the sudden realization that something enormous is awake and near.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Leave the presence, regroup, or the scene changes.

name: Stalking Pressure
triggerText: When the Zone creature pursues before clear contact.
familyNotes: Use before clear contact, when the creature is only partly perceived or only inferred from signs.
description: The being's pursuit wears down nerve before it closes to strike.

magicEffects.Description: Wear down nerve with stalking pursuit.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A traveler or trespasser who knows, or thinks they know, that the Zone creature is near.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target hesitates, turns back, or loses discipline.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is overcome by dread, isolation, or hunted panic.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use before clear contact, when the creature is only partly perceived or only inferred from signs.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Leave the Zone, regroup safely, or the creature breaks off pursuit.
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Rally, blessing, clear shelter, trusted companionship

name: Lead From the Path
triggerText: When the Zone creature separates a target from the group.
familyNotes: False voices, wrong tracks, near-at-hand movement, or a compelling sense that the safe path lies elsewhere.
description: The being draws a victim away from safety, certainty, or the group.

magicEffects.Description: Draw the target from the path with doubt and false signs.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target moving through the Zone who can be separated from others.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target loses direction or strays slightly.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is led away, split off, or drawn into a bad approach.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for false voices, wrong tracks, near-at-hand movement, or a compelling sense that the safe path lies elsewhere.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Target is recovered, guided back, or leaves the Zone.
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Trusted guide, warded route, tethering, communal discipline

name: Sudden Taking
triggerText: When the Zone creature closes abruptly from partial perception into direct harm.
familyNotes: The exact bodily form may remain unclear even in attack; the important effect is abrupt dangerous contact from an only-half-seen hunter.
description: The being closes abruptly from partial perception into direct harm.

magicEffects.Description: Overtake the target with abrupt dangerous contact.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target isolated, cornered, or overtaken by the Zone creature.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target is struck, grazed, or partially seized.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is overtaken and weakened by sudden contact with the creature.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: The exact bodily form may remain unclear even in attack; the important effect is abrupt dangerous contact from an only-half-seen hunter.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: End of scene or recovery
magicEffects.RemovalMethod: Rest, treatment, rescue, removal from the Zone

magicEffects.Description: Direct harm from sudden contact.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target caught by the Zone creature.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Direct-harm payload alongside the Weakened condition.

name: Press the Fight
triggerText: When the person commits to immediate action.
familyNotes: Advancing with intent, seizing initiative, stepping into a strike, or maintaining formation pressure.
description: The person commits to immediate action, closing distance or holding pressure.

magicEffects.Description: Commit forward with martial momentum.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: The person themselves.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for advancing with intent, seizing initiative, stepping into a strike, or maintaining formation pressure.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: After the push resolves or the scene changes.
magicEffects.SuppressedBy: Panic, exhaustion, command failure, severe injury

name: Armed Strike
triggerText: When the person's weapon, tool, fist, or shield lands.
familyNotes: Spear-thrust, cudgel blow, sword-cut, shield-bash, knife strike, and similar human attacks.
description: A straightforward human attack using weapon, tool, fist, or shield.

magicEffects.Description: Strike with mortal arms and leave the target weakened.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target within reach of the attacker's current armament.
magicEffects.OnPartial: Target is rattled, bruised, or forced off balance.
magicEffects.OnFailure: Target is struck solidly and weakened.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Role and loadout variants should restyle this into spear-thrust, cudgel blow, sword-cut, shield-bash, knife strike, and similar human attacks.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: End of scene or recovery

magicEffects.Description: Direct physical harm.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: A target struck by ordinary human violence.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Sanitised from spec's 1d6-2 to a non-negative range (1d4).

name: Fall Back or Hold
triggerText: When the person braces under pressure or disengages before collapse.
familyNotes: Taking cover, backing off, bracing behind allies, slipping through a doorway, or staying alive by discipline rather than supernatural escape.
description: The person either braces under pressure or disengages before collapse.

magicEffects.Description: Brace or disengage with mortal discipline.
magicEffects.TargetDescription: The person themselves.
magicEffects.PayloadNotes: Use for taking cover, backing off, bracing behind allies, slipping through a doorway, or staying alive by discipline rather than supernatural escape.
magicEffects.ExpiryTrigger: Reveals themselves, recommits to the fight, or runs out of cover.
magicEffects.SuppressedBy: Encirclement or loss of escape route

name: Drag Down
triggerText: When the Undead's grave weight pulls a target off balance.
description: Pull the living down with corpse-mass.

magicEffects.Description: Drag the target down with grave weight.

name: Ride Through
triggerText: When the rider charges through a line or formation.
description: Speed and shock carry the rider through opposition.

magicEffects.Description: Charge with mounted momentum.

name: Slip Past the Gaze
triggerText: When the Hidden Folk slides out of clear sight.
description: Too quick and too half-seen to hold.

magicEffects.Description: Withdraw beyond ordinary perception.

name: Turn Back the Threat
triggerText: When a threat enters the spirit's grove or holding.
description: Warn enemies to retreat before punishment falls.

magicEffects.Description: Press intruders to retreat.

name: Follow the Quarry
triggerText: When the Beast picks up scent or sight of prey.
description: Instinct closes the gap.

magicEffects.Description: Surge after the quarry.

name: Lead to the Bad Ground
triggerText: When a target can be led astray by terrain or sign.
description: Misdirect into water, bog, or wrong path.

magicEffects.Description: Lead target astray.

name: Drive from the Range
triggerText: When intruders enter the Beast's den, range, or feeding ground.
description: Bare fang and threat to drive trespassers out.

magicEffects.Description: Drive intruders from the range.

name: Strike the One Who Caused This
triggerText: When the Cursed being lashes out at its maker or betrayer.
description: Curse-driven retaliation lands with extra force.

magicEffects.Description: Strike with curse-driven vengeance.

name: Commit to the Kill
triggerText: When hunger drives the Beast past caution.
description: Famine drives the strike home.

magicEffects.Description: Press the kill past caution.

name: Step Between Them
triggerText: When kin are in danger.
description: Place oneself between the threat and the protected.

magicEffects.Description: Intercept the blow meant for kin.

name: Offer the Side
triggerText: When the outsider presses a mortal toward allegiance.
description: Tempt with pact, allegiance, or service.

magicEffects.Description: Tempt the target toward the outsider's side.

name: Command in the Name of the Old Order
triggerText: When the Unseen exerts the authority of the parallel civilization.
description: Speak with the weight of the hidden world's law.

magicEffects.Description: Compel obedience through old-order authority.

name: Wake to Command
triggerText: When the dormant Construct is triggered by command or breach.
description: Sudden, total obedience replaces dormancy.

magicEffects.Description: Activate to imprinted task.

name: Resume the Old Habit
triggerText: When the dead thing tries to inhabit its old domestic routine.
description: Tragic repetition draws witnesses into old patterns.

magicEffects.Description: Pull witnesses into the old domestic pattern.

name: The Pattern Repeats
triggerText: When the curse's compulsion takes hold.
description: Inescapable repetition of the imposed pattern.

magicEffects.Description: Lock the Cursed being into its imposed pattern.

name: Bring the Wrongness With It
triggerText: When the Zone Colossus moves and warps the locality around it.
description: Manifest Zone wrongness as catastrophe expands.

magicEffects.Description: Mark the area with Zone wrongness.

name: Lead Astray
triggerText: When a traveler can be misled by woodland path or cover.
description: Mislead through forest cover.

magicEffects.Description: Mislead through the wood.

name: Turn the Path
triggerText: When a trespasser leaves the deer path or known way.
description: Twist the path back on itself.

magicEffects.Description: Twist the path against the intruder.

name: Break from the Brush
triggerText: When the Beast bursts from cover.
description: Sudden charge from concealment.

magicEffects.Description: Burst from cover at speed.

name: Mirror-Lure
triggerText: When a mortal stares too long at the water's surface.
description: Beckoning reflection from beneath.

magicEffects.Description: Lure the watcher into the water.

name: Beckoning Reflection
triggerText: When a mortal approaches the bank, ford, or pool.
description: Drowning beauty calls from the depth.

magicEffects.Description: Call the watcher into the depth.

name: Drowning Summons
triggerText: When the water sovereign calls to those at the crossing.
description: Sovereign summons from depth.

magicEffects.Description: Summon the target toward the water.

name: Break the Hull
triggerText: When the Colossus's bulk strikes a vessel or structure.
description: Vast force shatters built structure.

magicEffects.Description: Shatter the hull or structure.

name: Barrow Glamour
triggerText: When the hill folk extend an old hospitality to mortals.
description: Charm-bound by elder custom.

magicEffects.Description: Charm the visitor under barrow custom.

name: Old Curse
triggerText: When the hill spirit lays an old curse on the trespasser.
description: Place-bound malediction.

magicEffects.Description: Lay the old curse.

name: Household Blessing
triggerText: When the hidden folk reward a household's proper conduct.
description: Domestic favor from hidden hands.

magicEffects.Description: Bless the proper household.

name: Household Judgment
triggerText: When the household judge weighs the conduct of those within.
description: Severe judgment of work and order.

magicEffects.Description: Compel order through household judgment.

name: Spoil the Work
triggerText: When household offense calls for hidden reprisal.
description: Sour the work, curdle the day.

magicEffects.Description: Inflict bad fortune on the offender.

name: Blessing of the Holding
triggerText: When the farmstead spirit favors the household.
description: Local favor from a protective spirit.

magicEffects.Description: Bless the holding and its keepers.

name: Raise the Alarm
triggerText: When the watch calls for support against intruders.
description: Rouse the neighbors against the trespasser.

magicEffects.Description: Press intruders with the weight of community.

name: Advance in Line
triggerText: When the line advances under command.
description: Disciplined advance under banner.

magicEffects.Description: Advance with disciplined momentum.

name: Rise Among the Fallen
triggerText: When the slain return to the field of battle.
description: Battle-dead resume their march.

magicEffects.Description: Rise and resume the old slaughter.

name: Erase the Track
triggerText: When the Zone stalker covers its passage.
description: Leave no track or scent.

magicEffects.Description: Erase one's passage from detection.

name: Call Below
triggerText: When the under-earth folk summon a mortal to descend.
description: Whispered invitation from beneath.

magicEffects.Description: Suggest descent into the underways.

name: Mire-Clutch
triggerText: When the bog seizes the trespasser.
description: The wet ground refuses to let go.

magicEffects.Description: Hold the target in mud and reed.

name: Stone-Handed Blow
triggerText: When the stone spirit's heavy strike lands.
description: Weight of stone behind the blow.

magicEffects.Description: Strike with stone-weight.

name: Avalanche Warning
triggerText: When the mountain spirit warns of falling height.
description: Dread of falling earth and stone.

magicEffects.Description: Strike fear of avalanche.

name: Rise from the Grave
triggerText: When grave-anchored dead reassert their presence.
description: Climb back from tomb or churchyard.

magicEffects.Description: Reassert presence above the earth.

name: Seal the Bargain
triggerText: When the infernal extracts a binding promise.
description: Bind the mortal to a contract.

magicEffects.Description: Bind the target to an infernal pact.

name: Announce the Sentence
triggerText: When the angelic outsider passes a judgment.
description: Doctrinal sentence carries celestial force.

magicEffects.Description: Compel the sentenced to obey.

name: Call from the Verge
triggerText: When the border-haunter beckons from the edge.
description: Call off the last trustworthy path.

magicEffects.Description: Pull the traveler off the safe path.

name: Guard the Threshold
triggerText: When the golem holds a door, gate, or threshold.
description: Letter-bound labor refuses all passage.

magicEffects.Description: Brace against intruders at the threshold.

name: Whispering Service
triggerText: When the homunculus is sent to suggest.
description: Vessel-born life whispers urgings.

magicEffects.Description: Plant a whispered suggestion.

name: Courtly Favor
triggerText: When the courtly noble extends a charged gift.
description: Beautiful and weighty courtly favor.

magicEffects.Description: Bestow courtly favor on the chosen.

name: Mark the Quarry
triggerText: When the Hunt marks a mortal for pursuit.
description: Spectral hunter brands its quarry.

magicEffects.Description: Mark the chosen prey of the hunt.

name: Smoke Passage
triggerText: When the jinn passes through threshold as smoke.
description: Pass through barrier as smokeless fire.

magicEffects.Description: Cross threshold as fire and smoke.

name: Snow Blessing
triggerText: When the winter matron favors the obedient household.
description: Snow-mantle blessing on the proper home.

magicEffects.Description: Bless the household with winter favor.

name: Withdraw from Sight
triggerText: When eyes turn away or attention slips.
description: Slip from plain view.

magicEffects.Description: Withdraw partially from sight.

name: Answer the Insult
triggerText: When the offender breaks courtesy.
description: Curse the rude with bad fortune.

magicEffects.Description: Lay an ill-luck answer on the insult.

name: Beckon Across the Edge
triggerText: When a listener hesitates near water or wild edge.
description: Draw the listener across the wrong edge by a voice they trust.

magicEffects.Description: Speak a beckoning the listener follows the wrong way.

name: Follow the Blood-Scent
triggerText: When the prey bleeds or breathes nearby.
description: Mark prey for relentless pursuit.

magicEffects.Description: Lock onto the warm trail.

name: Name the Price
triggerText: When a mortal asks for aid or escape.
description: Offer a binding old-law trade.

magicEffects.Description: Name the cost of what was asked.

name: Stand for Their Own
triggerText: When kin or household are attacked.
description: Cover the household from harm.

magicEffects.Description: Stand fast for the household.

name: Recoil from Cold Iron
triggerText: When struck or warded by cold iron.
description: Recoil from worked iron.

magicEffects.Description: Glamour falters at iron contact.

name: Wait Beyond the Door
triggerText: When the threshold is closed against the visitor.
description: Make the household hesitate to refuse.

magicEffects.Description: Plant doubt in the keeper of the door.

name: Refuse Plain Sight
triggerText: When mortals try to see the whole.
description: Show only fragments to any one viewer.

magicEffects.Description: Refuse to be wholly seen.

name: Show the Wrong Face
triggerText: When a witness checks mirror, glass, or water.
description: Reveal the wrong face in reflection.

magicEffects.Description: Make the mirror disagree with the real.

name: Vanish with the Sun
triggerText: When daylight breaks or lanterns rise.
description: Withdraw with the failing dark.

magicEffects.Description: Fade as light asserts.

name: Reclaim the Gift
triggerText: When the grave-gift is held or moved.
description: Mark the bearer for inevitable visit.

magicEffects.Description: Mark the holder of the grave-gift.

name: Eyes Always Open
triggerText: When any creature comes under its gaze.
description: Mark all that pass the gaze.

magicEffects.Description: Lock the gaze on every passerby.

name: Wreck the Doorway
triggerText: When forced through a man-made structure.
description: Tear an opening to pass.

magicEffects.Description: Smash the doorway aside.

name: Wax with the Moon
triggerText: When moonlight or full night reaches the cursed.
description: Grow stronger under the moon.

magicEffects.Description: Wax with the night sky.

name: Wear the Veil
triggerText: When the body would be plainly observed or struck.
description: Withdraw the body into the zone's veil.

magicEffects.Description: Slip partially out of sight, leaving wrong glimpses behind.

name: Loom Over the Ground
triggerText: When the bulk reveals itself to witnesses below.
description: Break order and nerve by revealing the wrong scale.

magicEffects.Description: When the bulk reveals itself across the sky-line, watchers lose nerve and order alike.

name: Walk With Worse Wounds
triggerText: When struck by a wound that would stop the living.
description: Continue moving and striking despite ruinous damage.

magicEffects.Description: The corpse takes the wound and keeps coming.

name: Sweep on Wing
triggerText: When the shadow of the wing falls across the field.
description: Descend with wing-shadow and break the formation below.

magicEffects.Description: The shadow of the great wing falls, and watchers scatter or freeze.

name: Slow to Wake
triggerText: When mortals try to rouse or provoke the long-sleeper.
description: The colossal mind takes long to grasp that it is being attacked.

magicEffects.Description: Sluggish answer — but when it comes, it is total.

name: Take the Land
triggerText: When mortals try to use or cross the claimed ground.
description: The land remembers whose it is.

magicEffects.Description: Ground answers to the colossus, refusing safe passage.

name: Drag Toward Sleep
triggerText: When witnesses press their case against the woken colossus.
description: Press sleep onto the witnesses, the way it is pressed upon itself.

magicEffects.Description: Witnesses grow heavy and slow, drawn toward stillness.

name: Storm-Fall
triggerText: When the colossus turns its anger downward on the ground.
description: Strike from cloud-height with the storm's own answer.

magicEffects.Description: Lightning falls where the colossus looks.

name: Horn Before the Arrival
triggerText: When the zone-host moves toward its quarry.
description: Sound the warning that names the prey before the host is seen.

magicEffects.Description: Witnesses hear the host before they see it — and fear runs ahead.

name: Form as Place
triggerText: When witnesses try to locate the zone-being as one creature.
description: Refuse the form of a body; remain as terrain.

magicEffects.Description: The host shifts and disperses; no single blow finds a target.

name: Enduring Mark
triggerText: When a mortal looks upon the host and is recognized in turn.
description: Mark the witness for the rest of their natural life.

magicEffects.Description: A mark settles on the witness that other zone-things will read for years.

name: Mark for the Chase
triggerText: When witnesses break cover or are noticed by the host.
description: Choose the next quarry of the chase.

magicEffects.Description: The host fixes on the chosen — and from that moment, the chase has begun.

name: Pack-Take-Down
triggerText: When the pack closes on isolated prey.
description: Drag the isolated prey down by the pack's combined weight.

magicEffects.Description: Pulled to the ground by many at once.

name: Tusk Gore
triggerText: When the boar drives its charge into the target.
description: Drive tusks into the target and continue past.

magicEffects.Description: Tusks open the body and the charge does not stop.

name: Hold the Line
triggerText: When the knight stands in formation against a charge or press.
description: Hold ground against weight that would break a lesser fighter.

magicEffects.Description: Knight stands fast; allies hold beside.

name: Form on the Captain
triggerText: When the captain's order reaches the soldier in line.
description: Move to the ordered shape with drilled speed.

magicEffects.Description: The line answers, closes, advances.

name: Strike from the Roadside
triggerText: When the traveler reaches the chosen ambush.
description: Strike from cover and mark the traveler for the rest of the gang.

magicEffects.Description: The traveler is found and named for the band's purpose.

name: Stand With the Village
triggerText: When the village or its harvest is threatened.
description: Gather neighbours into a stand around the threatened ground.

magicEffects.Description: Neighbours close in; the village stands together.

name: Speak with the Watch
triggerText: When the commoner appeals to civic authority — watch, parish, guild.
description: Call on the town's own structures of order.

magicEffects.Description: Watch, parish, or guild takes notice of the appeal.

name: Slip the Hand
triggerText: When a mortal hand reaches to grasp the wee folk.
description: Twist out of the closing grip, leaving the mortal holding air.

magicEffects.Description: The hand closes on nothing; the small one is already gone aside.

name: Speak as a Folk
triggerText: When the hidden folk addresses mortals as equals or betters.
description: Speak in the manner of folk, not of wee things.

magicEffects.Description: Listeners hear what they take for ordinary speech; courtesy must answer courtesy.

name: Renew the Place
triggerText: When the place suffers wound, blight, or wrongful use.
description: Restore the place by the spirit's own bond to it.

magicEffects.Description: Mark of the wrong fades; the ground breathes again.

name: Spread the Blight
triggerText: When something pristine reaches the bounded ground.
description: Push the blight outward, taking what was clean.

magicEffects.Description: The clean ground takes the wrong; the harm extends.

name: Wander the Wrong Way
triggerText: When the land-lost spirit moves across foreign ground.
description: Pull others into the broken wandering.

magicEffects.Description: Mortals nearby lose direction and purpose.

name: Pass Through Walls
triggerText: When the spirit must reach what stone or door denies.
description: Move through what was meant to keep the living out.

magicEffects.Description: Wall, door, or earth offers no answer; the unbodied passes.

name: Bear More Wounds Than the Living
triggerText: When wounds that would stop the living strike the dead.
description: Continue moving and striking despite ruinous damage.

magicEffects.Description: The corpse takes the cut and keeps coming.

name: Will Not Lie Still
triggerText: When the unquiet body would be put to rest before its grievance is met.
description: Will not stay laid down or held to the grave.

magicEffects.Description: The body refuses rest and rises or stirs again.

name: Speak as the Court
triggerText: When the Sidhe addresses mortals on a matter of consequence.
description: Speak with the weight of the hidden court behind every word.

magicEffects.Description: Listeners feel old law and old courtesy press the matter.

name: Stand Older Than the Place
triggerText: When mortals lay claim to ground the ancient already held.
description: Assert the older claim and quiet the lesser one.

magicEffects.Description: Mortal claim falters; the older presence asserts itself.

name: Wait in the Wrong Corner
triggerText: When a mortal turns into a place the lurker has already chosen.
description: Strike from the corner the mortal didn't think to check.

magicEffects.Description: Ambushed from the angle no eye held.

name: Loom Across the Field
triggerText: When witnesses see the full scale at once.
description: Break the order of those who comprehend the scale.

magicEffects.Description: Lines break and morale collapses at the sight.

name: Bear's Maul
triggerText: When the bear closes its grip on the target.
description: Bring both forelimbs down on what stands in front.

magicEffects.Description: Bears down with mauling weight and ruinous force.

name: Bear the Curse
triggerText: When the cursed being asserts the weight of its curse upon a target.
description: Press the curse-mark onto the target.

magicEffects.Description: The mark settles; the target feels the weight of the curse pass through them.

name: Pester the Mortal
triggerText: When mortals work near where the lesser one waits.
description: Vex the mortal with small misfortune, dropped tools, soured cream.

magicEffects.Description: Small ills follow the mortal — pinpricks of bad luck and overheard whispers.

name: Exert the Named Power
triggerText: When the named outsider works the office it was named for.
description: Channel the specific authority the outsider is named to wield.

magicEffects.Description: The named office answers — the target is bound or shaped by it.

name: Command the Lesser
triggerText: When lesser outsiders or summoned servants are within reach of the noble's authority.
description: Bind lesser outsiders to the noble's purpose by court right.

magicEffects.Description: The lesser kin bow to the rank and answer the noble's command.

name: Issue the Decree
triggerText: When the prince pronounces from the throne of their office.
description: Speak a decree that binds at the scale of the prince's court.

magicEffects.Description: The decree settles upon the witness with the full weight of the outsider crown.

name: Read the Fight
triggerText: When the veteran reads the killing blow before it falls.
description: Mark the incoming threat before it lands.

magicEffects.Description: The veteran sees what is coming and braces or warns the line.

name: Cast the Spoken Work
triggerText: When the caster speaks the work against a target.
description: Cast the spoken charm against the listener.

magicEffects.Description: Mortal will bends to the spoken work.

name: Strike Unseen
triggerText: When the cloaked one strikes from cover.
description: Strike before the target knows the blow is coming.

magicEffects.Description: The target is hit before they can prepare; the strike marks them.

name: Vanish into the Earth
triggerText: When the burrower needs to leave the surface or appear elsewhere.
description: Slip beneath the ground and emerge at the chosen spot.

magicEffects.Description: The burrower drops out of sight into the soil.

name: Move Where Others Cannot Follow
triggerText: When the climber needs to reach what mortal hand cannot grasp.
description: Move along the vertical as if it were the floor.

magicEffects.Description: The climber takes a path no pursuer can follow.

name: Break Their Will
triggerText: When the terrifying one is fully seen by mortal witnesses.
description: Use the aspect to break the will of those who see it.

magicEffects.Description: Witnesses lose nerve at the sight.

name: Add to the Hoard
triggerText: When the greedy one takes a new prize for the hoard.
description: Claim the prize permanently for the hoard.

magicEffects.Description: The taken thing is marked as the hoarder's, recoverable only by force.

name: Follow and Watch
triggerText: When the curious one chooses a witness to follow.
description: Mark the witness for sustained observation.

magicEffects.Description: The witness becomes aware of being watched — and cannot fully shake the sense.

name: Set the Game
triggerText: When the bored one frames a contest for its own entertainment.
description: Make the witness an unwilling player in the sport.

magicEffects.Description: The witness is drawn into the game on the bored one's terms.

name: Carry the Order
triggerText: When the servant delivers or enforces its master's instruction.
description: Compel the listener to obey the master's order.

magicEffects.Description: The order falls on the listener with the weight of the absent master.

name: Take the Token
triggerText: When the collector takes a personal token from a defeated or marked target.
description: Claim the token; mark the source to be remembered.

magicEffects.Description: A piece of the source is taken; the source is marked for the collector's memory.

name: Set the Test
triggerText: When the tester poses the riddle or trial to a mortal.
description: Plant the test in the listener's mind; they cannot easily refuse it.

magicEffects.Description: The mortal hesitates, drawn into the riddle by curiosity or fear of refusal.

name: Lay the Grief
triggerText: When the mourner shares its loss with a witness.
description: Press the weight of mourning onto the witness.

magicEffects.Description: Witness is overcome by an unfamiliar grief, weakened by its weight.

name: Stand the Boundary
triggerText: When the boundary is threatened or crossed.
description: Brace at the bound place and refuse the trespass.

magicEffects.Description: The bound one stands; intruders find their effort blunted.

name: Pause at the Stream
triggerText: When the warded being is brought to the edge of running water.
description: Halts at the water-edge, weakened by the moving stream.

magicEffects.Description: The being falters at the water; cannot pass while it runs.

name: Recoil from the Bell
triggerText: When a bell is rung within hearing of the warded being.
description: Bell-sound staggers and forces withdrawal.

magicEffects.Description: The being recoils, weakened by the ringing.

name: Withdraw from the Salt
triggerText: When salt is placed or thrown against the warded being.
description: Recoils from the salt and seeks an unsalted line.

magicEffects.Description: The being withdraws from the salted ground, weakened where it touched.

name: Become Caught in the Count
triggerText: When countable items are spilled before the counter.
description: Cannot turn aside; the count must be finished.

magicEffects.Description: The counter is fixed in place until every grain is accounted for.

name: Bound to the Answer
triggerText: When a direct question is put to the truth-bound being.
description: Must answer — the answer obeys the listener's question, however shaped.

magicEffects.Description: The being answers truthfully, and the listener is bound to the answer they receive.

name: Hear the Price
triggerText: When a mortal opens an offer to the bargain-bound.
description: Cannot turn away; the price must be heard and answered.

magicEffects.Description: The bound being engages the offer despite better judgment.

name: Falter in the Sun
triggerText: When direct sunlight strikes the warded being.
description: Sun-touch weakens; must retreat to shadow.

magicEffects.Description: The being's strength fades under the open sun.

name: Recoil at the Threshold
triggerText: When the warded being approaches consecrated ground.
description: Cannot cross; hesitates and turns at the threshold.

magicEffects.Description: The being falters; doubt and weakness press it back from the holy line.

name: Find the Old Witness
triggerText: When a mortal who has once seen the being is encountered again.
description: Recognize the witness immediately and mark them anew.

magicEffects.Description: The witness is recognized and re-marked — escape is harder for the seen.

name: Recoil from the Rowan
triggerText: When rowan is placed against or before the warded being.
description: Rowan-touch saps strength and turns the being aside.

magicEffects.Description: The being recoils, weakened where the rowan touched.

name: Slip the Count
triggerText: When witnesses try to count or describe the being's numbers.
description: Refuse to be reckoned by mortal counting.

magicEffects.Description: Witnesses come away with different counts, different descriptions.

name: Refuse the Name
triggerText: When the being is asked to name itself or another.
description: Cannot speak the true name; deflects with false names or silence.

magicEffects.Description: The listener gets a false name; the true name remains hidden.

name: Hold to the Path
triggerText: When the being is asked or forced to leave its appointed route.
description: Cannot deviate; if forced off the path, the route must be resumed.

magicEffects.Description: The path-bound is marked by its route; deviation falters and reverses.

name: Open the Door
triggerText: When a stranger asks for shelter or hearing in the proper form.
description: Must open and offer; cannot refuse the guest-right.

magicEffects.Description: The guest is admitted, however unwise; old hospitality binds the host.

name: Pause at the Crossing
triggerText: When the being reaches a crossroads.
description: Must halt; cannot pass without the four-wind question.

magicEffects.Description: The being falters at the meeting of ways, weakened by the obligation.

name: Recoil from the Flame
triggerText: When flame is presented against the warded being.
description: Recoils sharply from open fire.

magicEffects.Description: The being staggers, weakened where the flame touched.

name: Recoil from the Hazel
triggerText: When hazel is presented or struck against the warded being.
description: Hazel-touch saps strength and turns the being aside.

magicEffects.Description: The being recoils, weakened by the protective wood.

name: Bound by the Spoken Name
triggerText: When a mortal speaks the being's true name aloud.
description: Must answer the name-caller; cannot ignore the binding.

magicEffects.Description: The named being turns, hesitates, bound by the spoken truth.

name: Wounded by the Word
triggerText: When devotion-words are spoken plainly within hearing of the warded being.
description: Prayer-words wound; the being staggers under devotion.

magicEffects.Description: The being is weakened; the spoken devotion lands like a blow.

name: Mend Under the Moon
triggerText: When the wounded being stands under moonlight or open night sky.
description: Moonlight closes the wound; strength returns.

magicEffects.Description: Wounds mend visibly under the moon's reach.

name: Refuse the Bleeding
triggerText: When the being takes a wound that should bleed.
description: Wound closes or stays dry; no bleeding follows.

magicEffects.Description: The wound is taken; nothing flows from it.

name: Walk Beneath the Water
triggerText: When the being is immersed or forced beneath water.
description: Walks the bottom or surfaces at will; water does not kill.

magicEffects.Description: The being moves freely through water; drowning is no threat.

name: Reveal the Tell
triggerText: When a witness notices the missing shadow.
description: The lack of shadow betrays the wrong-thing-ness to careful eyes.

magicEffects.Description: The witness marks the being as not-mortal.

name: Stir the Beasts
triggerText: When animals are within sense-range of the being.
description: Animals stir, refuse, or bolt — alerting their owners.

magicEffects.Description: Local animals mark the being; their owners take notice.

name: Strike Twice
triggerText: When the being engages in combat with hand or limb.
description: Grants a second strike in the same action.

magicEffects.Description: The being delivers an additional strike in the same turn.

name: Take a Companion
triggerText: When the lonely one finds a candidate to fill the empty place.
description: Draw the witness into the lonely one's circle.

magicEffects.Description: The witness is drawn closer, charmed by the offered place.

name: Press Toward the Place
triggerText: When obstacles slow the pilgrim's journey.
description: Press forward despite weight, weather, or interference.

magicEffects.Description: The pilgrim moves with new purpose; ordinary delays fall away.

name: Pronounce the Sentence
triggerText: When a witness has clearly broken the punisher's rule.
description: Lay the punishment on the rule-breaker.

magicEffects.Description: The rule-breaker is cursed by the sentence pronounced.

name: Set the Trick
triggerText: When the trickster sees an opening for mischief.
description: Plant the trick where the witness will fall into it.

magicEffects.Description: The witness is caught hesitating between two false answers.

name: Seek the Final Rest
triggerText: When the weary one drops its guard, hoping the witness will end it.
description: Lay down what strength remains; let the end come.

magicEffects.Description: The weary one weakens, inviting the final stroke.

name: Open the Way
triggerText: When the liberator finds a soul it judges fit to be freed.
description: Mark the chosen for release, by death or by transformation.

magicEffects.Description: The chosen is marked; the liberator's path will find them again.

name: Add to the Work
triggerText: When the maker takes raw matter — material, person, place — for the work.
description: Mark the thing for incorporation into the ongoing work.

magicEffects.Description: The taken thing is marked as the maker's; reclaim is hard.

name: Carry the Doctrine
triggerText: When the speaker presses the doctrine onto a fresh listener.
description: Plant the doctrine in the listener's mind.

magicEffects.Description: The listener carries the message away, weighing it whether they wished to or not.

name: Find the Trail
triggerText: When the seeker catches sign of the lost thing.
description: Lock onto the trail; the marked sign cannot be hidden from this attention.

magicEffects.Description: The sign of the lost thing is marked; the seeker follows.

name: Note the Crossing
triggerText: When the witness sees a crossing of the rule, vow, or boundary it watches.
description: Mark the crosser permanently in the witness's record.

magicEffects.Description: The crosser is marked; the witness will know them, and so will any who share the watch.
